report:
Conclusion: I cannot identify any specific, meaningful difference between the checkpoints from this evidence.

Why:
- The L2 norms are zero (or effectively zero) at every (layer, position) cell, so there is no concentrated residual-stream signal to inspect.
- The logit-lens top tokens are just common small tokens/whitespace (e.g. " o", "is", "it", "\n", "in", " a") — the sort of noisey, high-frequency tokens you see when there is no strong, coherent direction.
- The patchscope continuations look like the model echoing/reflecting the identity-style prompt (e.g. "cat -> cat", "hello -> hello"), and they are the same across the injected layers. That pattern is consistent with either (a) the baseline model behavior for the identity prompt, or (b) an extremely small / non-interpretable difference that doesn’t produce a distinct semantic direction.

Taken together, the data are consistent with a near-zero or non-interpretable residual difference; there isn’t enough evidence to name a specific objective, domain, or behavioral change.
